comment: SYNTHETIC IP enrichment data for the forensics-agent evaluation scenarios ONLY. This is NOT real threat intelligence: it is a static, committed map written by tools-engineer so the enrich_ip tool can return deterministic results without querying any real reputation service or system. Reputation answers are marked with their source via a reputation_source:* label. IPs use RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) and RFC 1918 private ranges.
